name: button-active
blurb: Button with shadow that grows on hover, shrinks to nothing on press.
description: A button that starts with no shadow and translates down and right. On hover, a shadow appears and the button translates back to its origin. On active/press, the shadow disappears again and the button translates down.
use_when: A playful CTA with tactile feedback for both hover and click states.
a11y: Native button element with full keyboard support.
